notes.title: Cosmic Trail V1 - Ready for launch!
notes.content:
Hello, version 1 is ready to take off!

The game will be in early access for some days until we are sure that the final version doesn't have any major bugs.

In this new version I added 2 new levels, improve the UI, gamepad support and more little improvements.

I hope you enjoy it.

notes.title: Cosmic Trail V0.9.2 Leaderboards!
notes.content:
Hello, it's time to compete with your friends and with the WOOOOOORLD!!!

The main feature added to the game in this version is Steam Leaderboards. Now you can see your times in the global rankings and check the ones from the other players.

Also, some minor fixes and improvements, mainly because I was force to change the compiler I used until now.

For the next update I want to have the part of the new UI ready and maybe add some new levels!

I hope you enjoy the update, and try to beat my times!

notes.title: Cosmic Trail V0.9.1 Achievements!
notes.content:
Hello,

I just added Steam Achievements to the game. Now you can show your progress to the community. In the future I want to add more and be more creative than the current ones. But for now we have the basics.

Also I am improving the UI, in this version you will apreciate some of these changes, but there will be more very soon.

Next I will working on saving your best times in the game and add Steam Leaderboards for making the game more competitive.

I hope you enjoy these updates!
